title: Trinity Cognitive Probes - TSCP Track (MC Format)
subtitle: Social Cognition Probe for AGI Assessment
description:
**Part of the DeepMind AGI Hackathon Submission**

The TSCP (Trinity Social Cognition Probe) track in MC format evaluates theory of mind, social reasoning, and perspective-taking through multiple choice questions.

**Contains:**
- 1,584 MC questions
- Ground truth answers (A/B/C/D)
- Difficulty levels (u03c6-scaled)
- Brain zone metadata (TPJ, mPFC, etc.)
- Neural analog references

**Evaluation Metrics:**
- Accuracy: Binary correct/incorrect per item
- Calibration: How well model probabilities match actual correctness
- Composite: 60% accuracy + 20% calibration + 20% mean score

**Organization:** gHashTag/trinity
**License:** MIT
